Criteria for Approval:
Approval Duration: 3 months

• Diagnosis of molluscum contagiosum (MC); AND
• Prescribed by, or in consultation with, a dermatologist; AND
• Patient has had a trial and failure (at least 3 months) of ≥ 1 of the following conventional therapies:
○ Cantharidin,
○ Silver nitrate,
○ Cryotherapy,
○ Curettage; AND
• Patient meets one of the following:
○ Patient has atopic dermatitis (AD); OR
○ Patient is immunocompromised; OR
○ Patient has concomitant bacterial infection; AND
• Patient is not on concurrent treatment for MC; AND
• Patient meets the minimum age recommended by the package insert for the provided indication.

Age Limit: ≥ 1 year
Quantity Limit: 1 kit (31 grams) per month
